description: Stylometry validation corpus: four synthetic authors, ten samples each (120-180 words), modelled on the register of darknet threat notes, vendor bulletins, and leak write-ups. No real author is represented. Topics deliberately vary within each author so the test measures writing habit rather than subject matter. Author C writes code-mixed Hinglish with Devanagari and emoji, which the pre-Phase-9 normalizer silently destroyed. Burrows' Delta and LZW/NCD are gated below 40 tokens and 80 characters respectively, so every sample here is comfortably above both floors.

A.profile: terse, all lowercase, almost no punctuation, heavy technical abbreviation, blunt imperatives
samples: host came back up again after three days down same fault as before they keep rotating the key on the second node and the payload never lands clean on first run it just times out and retries until the process gets killed by the watchdog which is set to thirty seconds so the whole thing is basically useless right now i need to look at the retry backoff again and maybe bump the watchdog to ninety or just drop the watchdog entirely and rely on the supervisor to restart it which is what it does anyway so the watchdog is redundant at this point and just adds noise to the logs that nobody reads except me when something breaks at three in the morning

pushed a new build to the drop server last night the beacon now sleeps forty seconds with fifteen percent jitter and rotates the user agent string on every cycle so the traffic blends with normal browser requests the tls fingerprint is still the same as the old build which means any defender fingerprinting on ja3 will catch it immediately so i still need to rotate the certificate and the cipher list but that requires access to the panel which i do not have at the moment because the operator changed the credentials last week and has not sent them over again

pulled the logs from the relay again this morning and there is still nothing since tuesday not a single callback not even a failed one which is strange because a failed connection would still leave a connection attempt in the firewall log on their side and the absence of that means either the egress is completely blocked or the implant is not running at all i checked the scheduled task on the host and it was still there with the correct binary path and the last run time was two days ago so something removed it between then and now and i have no idea what

the wallet is definitely the same one from the previous job the peel chain resolves cleanly to a single root and the change address was mixed in with two other outputs at the same value which is the standard pattern they use to break the link between the victim payment and the consolidated wallet the consolidation address has now received funds from four separate victims over eleven days and the total is a little over ninety ether which is a substantial amount for a group this size and it suggests they are consolidating before some larger move

the loader now checks for sandbox artifacts before unpacking anything if it sees strings like vmware or vbox or a low process count or a suspicious user name it simply exits quietly without touching disk and without dropping the payload which kills most automated analysis but it also means the sample will not run on a bare metal recovery image so the operator has to test manually which slows them down and is probably why the campaign has been quiet for the last month while they rewrite the loader to work in both environments

still working on the persistence piece it writes to the startup folder and also registers a scheduled task that triggers on logon and survives a reboot but defender flags the task creation as suspicious and quarantines the file on a significant number of endpoints so the current approach works on older windows versions and on systems where the defender exclusions have been pushed but it is going to stop working entirely once the group upgrades so the next iteration needs to move away from the startup folder and away from scheduled tasks and toward something less conventional but i do not have a good alternative that does not require kernel access

encryption is standard aes two hundred fifty six with the key derived from the machine identifier through pbkdf2 with a hundred thousand iterations which is not enough by current standards but it is enough to stop anyone from recovering the files without paying so the operational tradeoff is acceptable for them the problem is that reinstalling the operating system changes the machine identifier which means the old files become permanently unrecoverable even for the attacker so if the operator reimplements the implant carelessly on a target that has already been encrypted once they will lose their own access to the data and that is a real risk to the whole business model

domain list updated with twelve new entry points the old ones are burned meaning the sinkhole operator has already taken them down so we rotate every forty eight hours and the resolver runs through two different providers in parallel and takes whichever answer arrives first which is not ideal because a hijacked response could send traffic to an analyst sinkbox but in practice the failure rate of the public resolvers is low enough that the added resilience is worth the risk and we have not lost a single callback to resolver issues in the last quarter

the c2 panel is behind cloudflare now so the callbacks look like ordinary https traffic to any content inspection system and the certificate is a letsencrypt certificate on a throwaway domain that was registered with a free email and paid for with a single use card so there is no meaningful attribution trail back to a payment instrument the panel itself is a stock administration panel that has been lightly modified to add the tasking features and the log viewer and the change is superficial enough that it will not survive a careful review by anyone who has seen the original product documentation

notes from the leak site suggest the group is hiring two people this quarter one for the tooling work and one for the loader development which is a change from the previous pattern where everything was built in house by two or three people the hiring post is written in careful english but it references internal project names that do not appear anywhere in the previous postings and the requirement for prior experience with a specific commercial panel product narrows the candidate pool considerably which is itself a small piece of attribution value

B.profile: long flowing sentences, subordinate clauses, semicolons, formal academic register, hedges
samples: Although the deployment was reported as successful by the operator, subsequent analysis of the collected telemetry revealed that the beacon interval had been misconfigured, which allowed the responding team to identify the traffic pattern with relative ease; had the interval been randomized, the detection would likely have taken considerably longer, and the incident might have been contained before any data was staged for exfiltration.

The operator has consistently favoured a modular architecture in which each component is delivered and updated independently of the others, and this design choice makes remediation considerably more difficult for a responding team because a partial containment leaves the operator able to reintroduce capability through a component that was not detected; this pattern has been observed in at least four separate campaigns attributed to the same group over the last eighteen months.

We observed a sustained period of inactivity lasting eleven days, during which no callbacks of any kind were recorded, and the absence of even failed connection attempts suggests that the operator was rebuilding infrastructure rather than simply pausing operations; this inference is supported by the fact that a new registration was created for one of the supporting domains on the ninth day of the silence, which is consistent with a migration rather than a hiatus.

It is worth noting that the ransom note exhibits a markedly different register from the material the group has published previously, adopting an unusually formal and almost legalistic tone that is inconsistent with the terse operational style seen in earlier postings; this shift may indicate that the note was drafted by a different individual, or that the group is now deliberately cultivating an appearance of legitimacy as it expands beyond extortion into data theft for direct sale.

The wallet addresses appear to have been generated in a strictly sequential order, and the clustering algorithm was able to recover the entire peel chain with a high degree of confidence across the transaction graph, with each hop representing a consolidation of a small number of inputs into a single output; the operator has used this pattern consistently across eleven distinct extortion events, and the consistency of the fee structure over that period suggests a single wallet management implementation rather than a set of independent actors.

Although the certificate presented by the infrastructure was self-signed and would ordinarily be disregarded as an indicator, its fingerprint was subsequently observed on an unrelated commercial host operated by a small logistics company, which is a strong indication of deliberate operational reuse rather than coincidence; the commercial host showed no other indicators of compromise, and the certificate appears to have been obtained specifically to lend an appearance of legitimacy to the malicious infrastructure rather than through any compromise of the legitimate operator.

Given that the group has historically avoided any form of public attribution claim, the recent published statement represents a meaningful departure from their established communication doctrine, and it is reasonable to infer that the change is driven by commercial rather than ideological considerations, most likely an attempt to rebrand following a public disclosure that made continued association with prior activity commercially untenable.

Our assessment is that the group retains access to at least one of the affected systems, because the indicators of compromise were observed within a network segment that should have been isolated following the initial notification, and the timing of the activity is inconsistent with residual automated behaviour; the possibility that a scheduled task survived the remediation is considered unlikely given the specific tooling involved, which requires interactive access to configure.

The timeline is difficult to reconcile with the published account of events, and we note that at least two of the referenced incidents could not be independently verified from the telemetry available to us, despite exhaustive collection from the affected environment; where the operator's account and the available evidence diverge, we have recorded both in the appendix rather than adopting either as established fact, since our role is to report what the evidence supports and not to adjudicate the dispute between the parties.

In summary, while the technical evidence linking the observed activity to this group is compelling and internally consistent across multiple independent artefacts, attribution to a specific individual remains speculative and would require corroboration from at least one source outside the technical domain; we therefore recommend that any attribution be presented as probabilistic, that the confidence level be stated explicitly alongside the finding, and that the absence of individual-level evidence be acknowledged rather than glossed over in the interest of producing a more decisive conclusion.

C.profile: Hinglish code-mixing, Devanagari mixed with romanized Hindi and English, frequent emoji, casual spoken register
samples: bhai सर्वर फिर se live है 3 दिन se बंद tha same hi issue है jo पेहले bhi aa raha tha key rotate कि है abhi wala node पे lekin payload first run पे clean nahi land ho raha timeout ho raha है aur watchdog thirty second पे है jo process ko maar deta है matlab pura system bekaar है ab retry backoff theek karna padega ya watchdog ko ninety second kar do warna supervisor khud restart kar dega to watchdog ki zarurat hi nahi है aur logs me sirf noise aa rahi है jo koi nahi padta 🔥

नया build drop सर्वर पे push kar diya kal raat ko beacon ab forty second sleep karta है aur fifteen percent jitter bhi laga diya है taaki traffic normal browser request jaisa lage lekin tls fingerprint purane build jaisa hi है matlab koi bhi ja3 se fingerprint karega to pakad lega isliye certificate aur cipher list bhi rotate karni है wo bhi pending है panel ka access nahi है abhi operator ne last week credential change कि tha aur abhi tak nahi bheja matlab ya bhool gaya ya jaan boojh kar nahi bhej raha 😅

raat ko relay के logs देखो pichle teen दिन se kuch nahi है na ek bhi callback na ek failed bhi jo nahi है normally firewall log me dikhta है agar egress block hota to wo bhi dikhta lekin wo bhi nahi है matlab ya to implant hi nahi chal raha ya poora egress block है maine host पे scheduled task check कि tha wo abhi bhi tha sahi binary path के saath aur last run time do दिन पेहले tha to kisi ne beech me hata diya है pata nahi kaise

wallet bilkul same है pichle wale का peel chain साफ saaf saaf single root पे resolve ho raha है change address do aur output के saath same value पे mix कि gaya है taaki victim payment aur consolidated wallet का link toot jaye consolidation address पे ab chaar alag victims का paisa aaya है last gyarah दिन me aur total ninety se thoda zyada ether है is group के liye badi amount है matlab kuch bada karne se pehle sab consolidate kar rahe हैं 👌

loader ab sandbox check karta है pehle kuch bhi unpack karne se pehle agar vmware ya vbox string dikhi ya process count kam है ya user name ajeeb है to seedha exit ho jata है disk ko chhooche bina aur payload bhi nahi drop karta isse zyada tar automated analysis fail ho jata है lekin matlab ye bhi है ki bare metal recovery image पे sample chalega hi nahi operator ko manually test karna padega jo unhe slow karta है isliye shayad isi liye pichle mahine campaign quiet raha 🤖

persistence abhi bhi startup folder aur scheduled task dono पे laga है logon पे trigger hota है aur reboot के baad bhi rehta है lekin defender task creation ko suspicious samajh ke file quarantine kar deta है bahut se endpoints पे to purane windows पे chalega jahan exclusions push कि gayi हैं par naye windows पे pura fail ho jayega isliye agla version startup folder aur scheduled task dono chhodega aur kuch less conventional use karega lekin mujhe koi achha alternative nahi pata जो kernel access na maange 😬

encryption normal aes two hundred fifty six है key machine identifier se pbkdf2 se nikaali jaati है ek lakh iteration जो aaj ke hisaab se kam है lekin itna kaafi है ki bina payment ke koi file recover na kar sake to operational tradeoff unke liye theek है masla ye है ki operating system dobara install karoge to machine id badal jayega aur purani files हमेशा ke liye band ho jayengi khud unke liye bhi matlab agar operator implant ghalat tareeke se dobara lagayega already encrypted machine पे to apna hi data kho dega aur pura business model khatam हमेशा

डोमेन list me twelve naye entry point add kiye purane sab burn ho chuke हैं matlab sinkhole operator ne sab utha liye ab har chhabas घंटे me rotate karte हैं resolver do alag provider से parallel chalta है aur jo pehle jawab de wahi use hota है jo perfect nahi है kyunki hijack hone se traffic analyst ke sinkbox पे ja sakta है lekin abhi resolver fail rate itna kam है ki added resilience का faida usse zyada है aur pichle quarter me ek bhi callback resolver कि wajah se gaya nahi

c2 panel ab cloudflare के peeche है to callbacks bilkul normal ह्यतस lagte हैं content inspection system ko aur certificate throwaway डोमेन का letsencrypt है jise free email se register कि gaya aur single use card se pay कि gaya है matlab koi meaningful trail payment instrument tak nahi jaati panel khud stock administration panel है jisme tasking aur log viewer add कि gaya है change itna halka है ki original product documentation dekhne wala koi bhi pakad lega 🔒

unke leak साइट पे likha है ki is quarter do log hire kar rahe हैं ek tooling के liye aur ek loader development के liye pehle sab kuch in house tha do teen logon ka group tha to ye pattern badla है post में english bahut careful है lekin andar के project names लिखे हैं jo पेहले kahin nahi dikhte aur ek specific commercial panel ka experience maang rahe हैं isse candidate pool bahut chhota ho jata है jo khud ek chhoti attribution value है 🇮🇳

D.profile: polite formal business English, frequent commas, passive voice, hedged modal verbs, no contractions
samples: Please be advised that the affected systems have been isolated pending further investigation, and that a forensic image has been preserved for examination; we would ask that no changes be made to the affected hosts until the relevant examination has been completed, as any such changes could compromise the integrity of the evidence that has been collected to date.

We would appreciate your cooperation in confirming whether the credentials that were disclosed in the course of this incident were subsequently rotated by your security team, and if so, at what point in time that rotation took place, as this information will materially assist us in determining the scope of the exposure and in assessing whether any further remedial action is required at this time.

It is anticipated that the remediation effort will require approximately two weeks, subject to the availability of the relevant engineering resources and to the availability of replacement hardware; should any of these assumptions prove to be incorrect, we will provide a revised estimate at the earliest opportunity, and we would ask that you notify us promptly should the circumstances change in a way that would affect the schedule described above.

The assessment has been shared with the relevant authorities, and a formal report will be submitted once the analysis has been completed; a summary of the principal findings is provided below for your convenience, and we would be happy to provide additional detail on any specific point should that be useful to your team as you consider the actions described in the preceding section of this correspondence.

Our team has reviewed the affected infrastructure and has identified three hosts that require immediate attention from the responding party, and we would recommend that these hosts be treated as compromised for the purposes of any subsequent risk assessment, since the tooling that was observed on them was capable of establishing persistence without any requirement for elevated privileges on the host in question.

Please note that any attempt to access the preserved evidence before the investigation has been concluded could compromise its evidentiary value, and might render the material unusable for the purposes of the proceedings that are anticipated to follow; we have therefore taken the precaution of restricting access to the relevant subset of the affected personnel, and we ask that this arrangement be respected until the investigation has been formally closed.

A summary of the findings is provided below, and the full technical appendix is available to authorized recipients on request; we have deliberately excluded certain details from this summary in the interest of clarity, and those details are instead set out in the appendix, which we would encourage you to review in full before determining what, if any, further action is required on your side.

The vendor has been contacted regarding the patch that was reported to resolve this issue, and a response has been requested; the vendor has indicated that a fix is expected to be made available in the next scheduled release, and we have requested that we be notified directly when that release becomes available so that we may validate the fix in our own environment before it is deployed more broadly across the estate.

We remain committed to supporting your organization throughout the remediation process, and we have offered additional resources where those are needed, including specialist support for the recovery of any data that may have been encrypted or removed, and we would ask that you contact us at your earliest convenience if there is any way in which we may be of further assistance during what we recognize is a difficult period for your team.

Should you require any clarification regarding the above, please do not hesitate to contact the undersigned at your earliest convenience, and we would be pleased to arrange a call at a time that is convenient for you; we recognize that there are likely to be many competing priorities at present, and we are happy to work around whatever schedule is most appropriate for your organization as we move forward together on the remaining items.
